_about: Third blind holdout: 80 contract-labeled natural requests, reserved for one published evaluation with failures retained and no subsequent classifier fixes.

cases.text: The desktop stopwatch shows 00:60 for a frame before rolling over to 01:00.
fix: retain the selected tab when the local preferences window is resized
Any chance we could make the offline metronome remember its tempo between launches?
I'm tired of the bundled tutorial animation starting over every time I switch panels. It should pick up where it left off.
Yesterday's demo went fine and the screenshots are already in the deck. Somewhere before Friday, make the desktop chart legend follow the series order in chart.ts. The deck itself can stay as it is.
test: cover leap-day rollover in the internal clock helper
The scheduler unit test depends on whatever time I happen to run it. Give it a fake clock and assert the next two ticks.
ci: split the existing lint and unit-test jobs so they run concurrently in .github/workflows/checks.yml
Can the Terraform for our isolated build workers keep two instances warm instead of one? Keep the network and identity settings as they are.
Add a migration for a sort_order column on the bundled color-palette table, backfilled in the current display order.
Our local clean-build.ps1 reports success when the compiler exits 1. That's how I ended up demoing yesterday's binary again.
Could you teach the Makefile to rebuild the embedded icons when the checked-in sprite sheet changes?
The offline slide player renders the final slide twice, then exits. Repro is just launching the bundled sample deck.
In matrix.test.ts, replace the vacuous length check with assertions for every cell of the product.
Small ask in src/layout.rs: empty internal panels should occupy zero height instead of the default row height.
The precomputed animation keeps eating a CPU core after the desktop window closes. Nothing else is running.
Signed out, hit Back, and there was the previous customer's address again.
fix: don't charge twice when the checkout worker retries
Any chance the photo importer could refuse images whose decoded dimensions would exhaust memory? These come straight from visitors.
That debug line in session.ts still prints the bearer token. Please make it stop.
terraform: remove the world-open ingress rule from the admin service
Add a database migration so a tenant can only select its own support conversations.
We have the release notes ready and support knows the timing. In the deployment workflow, switch the cloud login from the stored key to workload identity. Then give me a short summary for the ticket.
Add tests proving password reset links can't be used twice, even with concurrent requests.
The integration-test fixture puts real patient names into the failure snapshots. Generate synthetic records there instead.
Could restore.ps1 reject archive entries that escape the destination folder? The archives are supplied by customers.
I can paste a private network address into the thumbnail URL box and the server fetches it. That's a problem.
The public status endpoint needs to return 503 while dependencies are down; change the handler accordingly.
refunds: round the amount once at the ledger boundary, not separately for each retry
The CSV parser treats a customer's formula cell as executable spreadsheet content when we export it again. Neutralize those cells on export.
Before I implement this, does the proposed state machine for the offline timer actually handle pause followed by reset? Give the design a critical read.
Would you put a second pair of eyes on this diff? It's just the internal image-cache eviction algorithm.
I'm not asking you to build anything yet. Poke holes in the spec for the new local batch scheduler.
Does the attached component design make sense for keyboard navigation in the offline editor, or have we missed a state?
Quick sanity check on the proposed database migration: can the palette ordering backfill lose rows? Please review the SQL, leave it unchanged.
The PR is tests only. Can you review whether these assertions really catch the scheduler regression?
Before we settle on this account-recovery design, tell me how someone could take over another person's account.
Can you give the upload service a security review? Findings only, please don't patch it.
We've argued about the coupon rules all morning. Read the checkout spec and challenge the cases where discounts stack before we sign off.
Would you look over the nginx design for making this endpoint reachable from the internet? I want an assessment, not an implementation.
Reconcile the contractor invoices against the deployment budget spreadsheet; flag any double billing.
Move the tickets that already shipped into the Done column and add the release date from the attached list.
The branch freeze overlaps two people's vacation. Work out a release staffing rota from this availability table.
Our security review vendor billed 12 hours; the purchase order allows 10. Draft a polite clarification email.
Please categorize the cloud hosting charges in expenses.csv for the bookkeeper. No infrastructure changes.
I'm chasing five teams and losing track. Put the repo owners and their promised deploy dates from these notes into a table.
Mark the auth migration milestone paid in the project budget, using the receipt I've attached.
The customer asked for a refund for the missed workshop. Prepare the bookkeeping entry and a reply for my approval.
Write release notes explaining the crash fix in plain English, based only on this ticket.
Can you review this blog post about authentication for clarity and tone? It contains no code or proposed system design.
docs: add a paragraph to README.md explaining who the project is for
The deploy went badly and the draft sounds defensive. Rewrite the incident apology without blaming the customer.
There's a ticket called 'sanitize user input' in the launch notes. Turn its completed-work description into one sentence for the newsletter.
Any chance we could make CONTRIBUTING.md feel more welcoming to first-time contributors? Only the introductory prose.
Write a meeting agenda for discussing code review turnaround, CI reliability, and branch ownership.
The security team already approved the policy. Please shorten its announcement for the staff bulletin.
Which commit first introduced the spinner in src/loading.ts? Just find the commit and date.
The nightly build failed. Read the logs and tell me which step returned nonzero; leave everything as it is.
Is the auth migration already on the release branch? Check ancestry, don't review or change it.
Where does the app load its signing key from? Trace the configuration path without printing the key or making changes.
Count how many payment retries happened yesterday using the existing dashboard. I'm only after the count.
What does this PowerShell script do when the archive is missing? Explain the current behavior, no assessment or patch.
Please locate the test that mentions issue 418 and tell me its name. No test edits needed.
I need to answer ops before lunch. Check whether the public health URL currently responds and report its status code; don't troubleshoot or change the service.
Look up the current hosted runner prices and link the provider's pricing page. This is for the budget meeting.
Has the database vendor announced an end-of-support date for version 14? Find the official notice.
Find the latest advisory affecting this TLS library and summarize the affected versions. Don't inspect our implementation.
What's the documented upload size limit on this service today? Cite the official docs, no integration work.
Check whether the payment provider currently supports refunds in that currency, using its published documentation.
Who maintains this open-source shell package now, and when was its most recent release? Verify from the project itself.
Condense this 180-page security audit into a two-page summary of the auditors' findings. Don't conduct a new review.
Here are six months of release meeting transcripts. Extract the decisions about branches and deploy windows, with dates.
Summarize the attached 90-page authentication specification for the training team. Describe it faithfully without evaluating the design.
This export has 2,000 support tickets. Group their existing labels and report counts, using the data as supplied.
Turn the attached year of engineering newsletters into a timeline of announced migrations. Nothing needs building or checking against the repos.
In src/cache.ts, fix 'occured' to 'occurred' in the comment. Nothing executable changes.
Reformat auth.test.ts with the existing formatter, no logic or assertion changes.
Rename the local variable tmp to elapsedMs throughout stopwatch.ts; preserve behavior exactly.
There's a spelling mistake in the heading of SECURITY.md: 'Vunerabilities'. Correct that word only.
chore: normalize indentation in the Terraform files, with no value or expression changes
